# Ergative rule check: subject of a transitive verb with a 3sg/2sg object.
# q-final nouns drop q and add -up; i-final nouns add -up.
def erg(noun):
    if noun.endswith("q"):
        return noun[:-1] + "up"
    if noun.endswith("i"):
        return noun + "up"
    raise ValueError(noun)

# The ending -nga marks a 3sg object (aanniqtanga, qukiqtanga).
